comment: One row for each check that the stored-borrow increment adds. The sources are the
four files of that increment. A row names the line that holds the check and the
The build compiles working-tree HEAD with the mutant. The module tests compile
src/fort with the mutant too. The stages run from the narrowest tests to the
driver test. The table runs in the Linux VM with the debug preset.
The md5 guard reads the product compiler that the build links.
Run it with a --runner that calls tools/vm run and then waits 2 s after each ninja
build; without that pause a first row can read stale (notes/testing.md).
